title: 收到生日聚会邀请：抓住人物、地点与时间
subtitle: 先听懂邀请的核心信息，再自然接受并确认细节

audio.title: An invitation to a party
audio.note: 官方音频总长约 2:26；本课已实际打开并连续播放核验 0:00–1:15（75 秒），使用第一条生日聚会留言。来源页提供完整 transcript。

sections.title: 1｜无字幕先听（5 分钟）
sections.body: 第一遍听 0:00–1:15，不暂停，只判断留言者为什么打电话。第二遍记录五项：感谢什么、什么聚会、有哪些人、在哪里、什么时候。不要逐词翻译形容房子的句子。回答后再打开 transcript 核对，然后关文字重听。
questions: 留言者为什么先向朋友道谢，之后发出了什么邀请？
聚会在什么时候、什么地方举行，规模大不大？
sections.answers:
1. 感谢生日卡片和留言；邀请朋友参加自己的生日聚会。
2. 本周五，在表亲位于乡下的房子里；规模不大，只有几位最亲近的朋友。

sections.title: 2｜精听辨音、连读弱读与跟读（4 分钟）
sections.body:
精听三处：
1. “How's it going?”：How's it 连读，going 是重心，整体当作问候词块。
2. “I'm organising a little party”：I'm 很短，organising 与 party 承担重音，a 弱读。
3. “I'd love to see you there”：I'd /aɪd/ 很短，to 弱读成 /tə/，love、see、there 形成邀请语气。

每句先听 3 次 → 看文字跟读两遍 → 关文字影子跟读 → 从头重听。模仿热情语气，不要把每个功能词读重。
sections.answers: 识别功能：How's it going? 是开场问候；I'm organising ... 给背景；I'd love to see you there 是明确邀请。

sections.title: 3｜原创阅读（4 分钟）
sections.body: Lena received a voice message from her friend Tom during work. Tom was planning a small birthday picnic for Sunday afternoon in a park near the river. He invited only six close friends and asked everyone to bring one snack or drink. Lena wanted to go, but she checked the important details before replying. She confirmed the starting time, asked whether the picnic would continue if it rained and offered to bring fruit. Tom replied that they would meet at two beside the main gate. If the weather was bad, they would move to his flat nearby. Lena accepted the invitation and added the plan to her calendar. She also asked if anyone needed a lift. A friendly invitation can sound casual, but confirming the date, place and backup plan prevents confusion and shows that you are genuinely interested.
questions: Which details did Lena confirm before accepting?
What did she offer to bring and do?
sections.translation: 莉娜上班时收到朋友汤姆的语音留言。汤姆计划周日下午在河边公园举办一个小型生日野餐，只邀请六位亲近朋友，并请每人带一种零食或饮料。莉娜想参加，但在回复前确认了重要信息。她确认开始时间，询问下雨时野餐是否继续，并主动说可以带水果。汤姆回复说大家下午两点在正门旁集合。如果天气不好，就转移到附近他的公寓。莉娜接受邀请并把计划加入日历。她还问是否有人需要搭车。友好的邀请听起来可能很随意，但确认日期、地点和备用方案能避免混乱，也表明你真的感兴趣。
sections.answers:
1. The starting time, meeting place and bad-weather plan.
2. She offered to bring fruit and give someone a lift.

sections.title: 4｜词汇与高频词块（4 分钟）
sections.body:
1. How's it going?｜最近怎么样？（高频词块）
Hi, how's it going?｜嗨，最近怎么样？
2. organise a party｜组织聚会（高频词块）
I'm organising a party for Sunday.｜我正在组织周日的聚会。
3. I'd love to see you there.｜很希望在那里见到你。（高频词块）
We're having dinner on Friday. I'd love to see you there.｜周五我们聚餐，很希望你能来。
4. I'd love to come.｜我很愿意来。（高频词块）
Thanks for inviting me. I'd love to come.｜谢谢邀请，我很愿意参加。
5. What time does it start?｜几点开始？（高频词块）
What time does the party start?｜聚会几点开始？
6. Where shall we meet?｜我们在哪里见面？（高频词块）
Where shall we meet if I drive?｜如果我开车，我们在哪里见？
7. Can I bring anything?｜我可以带什么吗？（高频词块）
Can I bring anything to the picnic?｜野餐我可以带点什么吗？
8. close friend｜亲近的朋友
Only a few close friends are coming.｜只有几位亲近朋友会来。
9. countryside｜乡下；郊外
Her cousin lives in the countryside.｜她表亲住在乡下。

sections.title: 5｜语法：be going to 表示已计划的活动（3 分钟）
sections.body:
be going to + 动词原形表示已经有计划或安排。邀请时可用 We're going to have ... 介绍活动。

例句：
1. We're going to have a party on Friday.｜我们周五要举办聚会。
2. I'm going to bring some fruit.｜我打算带些水果。

练习：
1. 填空：We ___ going to meet at two.
2. 改写：I plan to bring drinks. → I ___ bring drinks.
sections.answers:
1. are / 're
2. am going to / 'm going to

sections.title: 6｜原创对话、替换与快速回应（3 分钟）
sections.body:
双人对话：
A: Hi! I'm organising a small birthday picnic this Sunday. I'd love to see you there.
B: Thanks for inviting me. I'd love to come. What time does it start?
A: At two, near the main gate in Riverside Park.
B: Great. Can I bring anything?
A: Some fruit would be perfect.
B: No problem. What happens if it rains?
A: We'll meet at my flat instead. I'll send you the address.
B: Sounds good. See you Sunday!

替换练习：
1. birthday picnic / Sunday / fruit → dinner party / Friday / dessert。
2. Riverside Park / main gate → cousin's house / bus stop，并确认交通方式。

快速回应（5 秒内）：
1. 接受邀请并问时间。
2. 主动问能带什么。
3. 还没确定能否参加：礼貌说稍后确认。

口头任务（30–60 秒）：邀请朋友参加一个小聚会，说明原因、日期、时间、地点和要带的东西；再扮演对方确认两个细节。
sections.answers: 参考：1. I'd love to come. What time does it start? 2. Can I bring anything? 3. Thanks for inviting me. Can I check and let you know tonight?

sections.title: 7｜复习上一课与反馈（1 分钟）
sections.body:
复习 3 个词块：
1. I'm sorry, but I can't ...｜抱歉，但我不能……
2. Thanks for letting me know.｜谢谢你告诉我。
3. Is there anything I can do?｜有什么我能做的吗？

各造一句。回原聊天告诉我第一遍听懂比例、最卡的邀请句；也可发英文或语音完成口头任务。只有实际收到并分析语音后，我才评价发音。
sections.answers: 自检：5 秒内说出 I'd love to come / What time does it start? / Can I bring anything?
